    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[1:N+1]]

    s = [0] * (N + 2)
    for i in range(N):
        s[P[i]] = i + 1
    
    # Fenwick tree
    bit = [0] * (N + 2)
    
    def update(i):
        while i <= N:

            i += i & -i

        p_v = query(s[v])
